scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @chromashift/core && npm run build --workspace @chromashift/native-client && npm run native:build && npm run dev --workspace @chromashift/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @chromashift/core && npm run build --workspace @chromashift/native-client && npm run build --workspace @chromashift/desktop && npm run native:build
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @chromashift/core && npm run build --workspace @chromashift/native-client && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:repository && npm run native:test

scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run native:publish && npm run package:dir --workspace @chromashift/desktop
